description: A single-use link, valid 10 minutes, that opens the dashboard's connect flow for one platform. Give it to the user to open in their own browser: it works only for their signed-in account, signs nobody in and connects nothing by itself; they approve the platform's consent. Never open it yourself. If the platform isn't switched on, the page says so when the link is opened. Free.
name: recomention_connection_link
title: Make a connect link (no charge)
